1	import { SCALAR_STYLE, type ScalarStyle } from '../parser/events.ts'
2	import { type ScalarLayout } from './scalar_styler.ts'
3	
4	function hasBit (mask: number, bit: number): boolean { return (mask & (1 << bit)) !== 0 }
5	
6	// This should eventually be a presenter option, but collection styling,
7	// especially key layout, must be designed first to decide whether scalar and
8	// collection width limits should share an option or be configured separately.
9	const MIN_SCALAR_CONTENT_WIDTH = 40
10	
11	/**
12	 * Default scalar styling rules in application order.
13	 * See [Scalar styling](../../docs/scalar_styling.md) for usage details.
14	 *
15	 * @category AST
16	 */
17	const DEFAULT_SCALAR_STYLE_RULES = {
18	  applyQuoteFlowKeysOption,
19	  doubleQuoteForInvisibles,
20	  doubleQuoteWhitespaceOnly,
21	  applyForceQuotesOption,
22	  tryLongOrMultilineAsBlock,
23	  quoteInvalidPlain,
24	  fallbackToDoubleQuoted
25	} as const
26	
27	function _preferredQuotedStyle (layout: ScalarLayout): ScalarStyle {
28	  if (layout.presenterOptions.quoteStyle === 'single' &&
29	      hasBit(layout.allowedStylesMask, SCALAR_STYLE.SINGLE_QUOTED)) {
30	    return SCALAR_STYLE.SINGLE_QUOTED
31	  }
32	
33	  return SCALAR_STYLE.DOUBLE_QUOTED
34	}
35	
36	function applyQuoteFlowKeysOption (layout: ScalarLayout): void {
37	  if (!layout.presenterOptions.quoteFlowKeys) return
38	
39	  // quoteFlowKeys applies only to plain scalar keys in flow mappings.
40	  if (!layout.isKey || !layout.flowOnly || layout.style !== SCALAR_STYLE.PLAIN) return
41	
42	  layout.style = SCALAR_STYLE.DOUBLE_QUOTED
43	}
44	
45	function doubleQuoteForInvisibles (layout: ScalarLayout): void {
46	  if (layout.style === SCALAR_STYLE.PLAIN &&
47	      /[\t\x7F-\xA0\u2028\u2029\uFEFF\uFFFE\uFFFF]/.test(layout.node.value)) {
48	    layout.style = SCALAR_STYLE.DOUBLE_QUOTED
49	  }
50	}
51	
52	function doubleQuoteWhitespaceOnly (layout: ScalarLayout): void {
53	  // Block styles normally make multiline structure easier to see, but
54	  // whitespace-only content turns that structure into visually empty lines,
55	  // so force double quotes for this special case.
56	  if (layout.style === SCALAR_STYLE.PLAIN && /^\s+$/.test(layout.node.value)) {
57	    layout.style = SCALAR_STYLE.DOUBLE_QUOTED
58	  }
59	}
60	
61	function applyForceQuotesOption (layout: ScalarLayout): void {
62	  if (!layout.presenterOptions.forceQuotes) return
63	
64	  // forceQuotes applies only to plain values, not to mapping keys.
65	  if (layout.isKey || layout.style !== SCALAR_STYLE.PLAIN) return
66	
67	  layout.style = layout.node.value.includes('\n')
68	    ? SCALAR_STYLE.DOUBLE_QUOTED
69	    : _preferredQuotedStyle(layout)
70	}
71	
72	function tryLongOrMultilineAsBlock (layout: ScalarLayout): void {
73	  if (layout.style !== SCALAR_STYLE.PLAIN || layout.isKey) return
74	
75	  const value = layout.node.value
76	  const multiline = value.indexOf('\n') !== -1
77	
78	  // Literal and folded block style bits are always set together, so checking
79	  // either one is sufficient.
80	  if (!hasBit(layout.allowedStylesMask, SCALAR_STYLE.LITERAL_BLOCK)) {
81	    if (multiline) layout.style = SCALAR_STYLE.DOUBLE_QUOTED
82	    return
83	  }
84	
85	  const w = layout.presenterOptions.lineWidth
86	
87	  if (w === -1) {
88	    if (multiline) layout.style = SCALAR_STYLE.LITERAL_BLOCK
89	    return
90	  }
91	
92	  const availableWidth = Math.max(
93	    Math.min(w, MIN_SCALAR_CONTENT_WIDTH),
94	    w - layout.shiftOfContent
95	  )
96	
97	  let position = 0
98	  let shouldFold = false
99	
100	  // Check whether at least one line exceeds the width budget
101	  // and can be split at a space.
102	  while (position <= value.length) {
103	    let lineEnd = value.length
104	
105	    const nextLineBreak = value.indexOf('\n', position)
106	
107	    if (nextLineBreak !== -1) lineEnd = nextLineBreak
108	
109	    const line = value.slice(position, lineEnd)
110	
111	    if (line.length > availableWidth &&
112	        line[0] !== ' ' &&
113	        / [^ \t]/.test(line)) {
114	      shouldFold = true
115	    }
116	
117	    if (nextLineBreak === -1) break
118	    position = nextLineBreak + 1
119	  }
120	
121	  if (shouldFold) {
122	    layout.style = SCALAR_STYLE.FOLDED_BLOCK
123	  } else if (multiline) {
124	    layout.style = SCALAR_STYLE.LITERAL_BLOCK
125	  }
126	}
127	
128	function quoteInvalidPlain (layout: ScalarLayout): void {
129	  if (layout.style === SCALAR_STYLE.PLAIN &&
130	      !hasBit(layout.allowedStylesMask, SCALAR_STYLE.PLAIN)) {
131	    layout.style = _preferredQuotedStyle(layout)
132	  }
133	}
134	
135	function fallbackToDoubleQuoted (layout: ScalarLayout): void {
136	  if (!hasBit(layout.allowedStylesMask, layout.style)) {
137	    layout.style = SCALAR_STYLE.DOUBLE_QUOTED
138	  }
139	}
140	
141	export { MIN_SCALAR_CONTENT_WIDTH, DEFAULT_SCALAR_STYLE_RULES }

1	import { SCALAR_STYLE, type ScalarStyle } from '../parser/events.ts'
2	import { type Node, type ScalarNode } from './nodes.ts'
3	import { type PresenterOptions } from './presenter.ts'
4	import { MIN_SCALAR_CONTENT_WIDTH } from './styler_defaults.ts'
5	
6	/** Scalar presentation state passed to styling rules. @category AST */
7	interface ScalarLayout {
8	  readonly node: Readonly<ScalarNode>
9	  readonly parent: Readonly<Node> | null
10	  readonly level: number
11	  readonly isKey: boolean
12	  readonly flowOnly: boolean
13	  readonly shiftOfParent: number
14	  readonly shiftOfContent: number
15	  readonly shiftOfFirstLine: number
16	  readonly presenterOptions: Readonly<Required<PresenterOptions>>
17	  /**
18	   * Bit mask of allowed styles; each bit corresponds to a {@link SCALAR_STYLE}
19	   * value.
20	   */
21	  allowedStylesMask: number
22	  /**
23	   * Selected output style, which styling rules may modify. To avoid overriding
24	   * earlier decisions, a rule should normally modify it only while it is
25	   * {@link SCALAR_STYLE.PLAIN}.
26	   */
27	  style: ScalarStyle
28	}
29	
30	/** Function signature for scalar styling rules. @category AST */
31	type ScalarStyleRule = (layout: ScalarLayout) => void
32	
33	function setBit (mask: number, bit: number): number { return mask | (1 << bit) }
34	
35	// YAML 1.2.2 character productions.
36	// https://yaml.org/spec/1.2.2/#51-character-set
37	const SRC_C_PRINTABLE = '[\\x09\\x0A\\x0D\\x20-\\x7E\\x85\\xA0-\\uD7FF\\uE000-\\uFFFD\\u{10000}-\\u{10FFFF}]'
38	const SRC_B_CHAR = '[\\n\\r]'
39	const SRC_C_BYTE_ORDER_MARK = '\\uFEFF'
40	const SRC_S_WHITE = '[ \\t]'
41	const SRC_NB_CHAR = `(?:(?!(?:${SRC_B_CHAR}|${SRC_C_BYTE_ORDER_MARK}))${SRC_C_PRINTABLE})`
42	const SRC_NS_CHAR = `(?:(?!${SRC_S_WHITE})${SRC_NB_CHAR})`
43	
44	// YAML 1.2.2 [2] nb-json.
45	const SRC_NB_JSON = '[\\x09\\x20-\\uD7FF\\uE000-\\uFFFF\\u{10000}-\\u{10FFFF}]'
46	
47	// YAML 1.2.2 indicator productions.
48	// https://yaml.org/spec/1.2.2/#54-indicator-characters
49	const SRC_C_INDICATOR = '[-?:,\\[\\]{}#&*!|>\'"%@`]'
50	const SRC_C_FLOW_INDICATOR = '[,\\[\\]{}]'
51	
52	// YAML 1.2.2 [127]-[129] ns-plain-safe(c).
53	// https://yaml.org/spec/1.2.2/#733-plain-style
54	const SRC_NS_PLAIN_SAFE_FLOW_OUT = SRC_NS_CHAR
55	const SRC_NS_PLAIN_SAFE_FLOW_IN = `(?:(?!${SRC_C_FLOW_INDICATOR})${SRC_NS_CHAR})`
56	
57	// YAML 1.2.2 [126] ns-plain-first(c).
58	const SRC_NS_PLAIN_FIRST_FLOW_OUT =
59	  `(?:(?:(?!${SRC_C_INDICATOR})${SRC_NS_CHAR})|[?:-](?=${SRC_NS_PLAIN_SAFE_FLOW_OUT}))`
60	const SRC_NS_PLAIN_FIRST_FLOW_IN =
61	  `(?:(?:(?!${SRC_C_INDICATOR})${SRC_NS_CHAR})|[?:-](?=${SRC_NS_PLAIN_SAFE_FLOW_IN}))`
62	
63	// YAML 1.2.2 [130] ns-plain-char(c).
64	// The production itself requires lookbehind, so these regexps require ES2018 lookbehind support.
65	// const SRC_NS_PLAIN_CHAR_FLOW_OUT =
66	//   `(?:(?:(?![:#])${SRC_NS_PLAIN_SAFE_FLOW_OUT})|(?<=${SRC_NS_CHAR})#|:(?=${SRC_NS_PLAIN_SAFE_FLOW_OUT}))`
67	// const SRC_NS_PLAIN_CHAR_FLOW_IN =
68	//   `(?:(?:(?![:#])${SRC_NS_PLAIN_SAFE_FLOW_IN})|(?<=${SRC_NS_CHAR})#|:(?=${SRC_NS_PLAIN_SAFE_FLOW_IN}))`
69	
70	// ES2015-compatible alternative without lookbehind: consume each run of hashes
71	// together with the preceding non-hash ns-plain-char.
72	const SRC_NS_PLAIN_CHAR_FLOW_OUT =
73	  `(?:(?:(?![:#])${SRC_NS_PLAIN_SAFE_FLOW_OUT})|:(?=${SRC_NS_PLAIN_SAFE_FLOW_OUT}))#*`
74	const SRC_NS_PLAIN_CHAR_FLOW_IN =
75	  `(?:(?:(?![:#])${SRC_NS_PLAIN_SAFE_FLOW_IN})|:(?=${SRC_NS_PLAIN_SAFE_FLOW_IN}))#*`
76	
77	// YAML 1.2.2 [132] nb-ns-plain-in-line(c).
78	const SRC_NB_NS_PLAIN_IN_LINE_FLOW_OUT = `(?:${SRC_S_WHITE}*${SRC_NS_PLAIN_CHAR_FLOW_OUT})*`
79	const SRC_NB_NS_PLAIN_IN_LINE_FLOW_IN = `(?:${SRC_S_WHITE}*${SRC_NS_PLAIN_CHAR_FLOW_IN})*`
80	
81	// YAML 1.2.2 [133] ns-plain-one-line(c).
82	const SRC_NS_PLAIN_ONE_LINE_FLOW_OUT =
83	  `${SRC_NS_PLAIN_FIRST_FLOW_OUT}#*${SRC_NB_NS_PLAIN_IN_LINE_FLOW_OUT}`
84	const SRC_NS_PLAIN_ONE_LINE_FLOW_IN =
85	  `${SRC_NS_PLAIN_FIRST_FLOW_IN}#*${SRC_NB_NS_PLAIN_IN_LINE_FLOW_IN}`
86	const SRC_NS_PLAIN_ONE_LINE_BLOCK_KEY = SRC_NS_PLAIN_ONE_LINE_FLOW_OUT
87	const SRC_NS_PLAIN_ONE_LINE_FLOW_KEY = SRC_NS_PLAIN_ONE_LINE_FLOW_IN
88	
89	// YAML 1.2.2 [134] s-ns-plain-next-line(n,c).
90	// ScalarNode.value contains the folded value, not the source text: one source
91	// line break became a space, while k > 1 breaks became k - 1 LF characters.
92	// The space case is already accepted by [132]; each remaining run of LFs
93	// therefore represents a transition to the next non-empty content line in [134].
94	const SRC_S_NS_PLAIN_NEXT_LINE_FLOW_OUT =
95	  `\\n+${SRC_NS_PLAIN_CHAR_FLOW_OUT}${SRC_NB_NS_PLAIN_IN_LINE_FLOW_OUT}`
96	const SRC_S_NS_PLAIN_NEXT_LINE_FLOW_IN =
97	  `\\n+${SRC_NS_PLAIN_CHAR_FLOW_IN}${SRC_NB_NS_PLAIN_IN_LINE_FLOW_IN}`
98	
99	// YAML 1.2.2 [135] ns-plain-multi-line(n,c).
100	const SRC_NS_PLAIN_MULTI_LINE_FLOW_OUT =
101	  `${SRC_NS_PLAIN_ONE_LINE_FLOW_OUT}(?:${SRC_S_NS_PLAIN_NEXT_LINE_FLOW_OUT})*`
102	const SRC_NS_PLAIN_MULTI_LINE_FLOW_IN =
103	  `${SRC_NS_PLAIN_ONE_LINE_FLOW_IN}(?:${SRC_S_NS_PLAIN_NEXT_LINE_FLOW_IN})*`
104	
105	// YAML 1.2.2 [131] ns-plain(n,c).
106	const NS_PLAIN_FLOW_OUT = new RegExp(`^(?:${SRC_NS_PLAIN_MULTI_LINE_FLOW_OUT})$`, 'u')
107	const NS_PLAIN_FLOW_IN = new RegExp(`^(?:${SRC_NS_PLAIN_MULTI_LINE_FLOW_IN})$`, 'u')
108	const NS_PLAIN_BLOCK_KEY = new RegExp(`^(?:${SRC_NS_PLAIN_ONE_LINE_BLOCK_KEY})$`, 'u')
109	const NS_PLAIN_FLOW_KEY = new RegExp(`^(?:${SRC_NS_PLAIN_ONE_LINE_FLOW_KEY})$`, 'u')
110	
111	// YAML 1.2.2 [118]-[125], projected to ScalarNode.value: doubled quotes
112	// are already decoded, and flow folding represents content line feeds as LF.
113	const NB_SINGLE_ONE_LINE = new RegExp(`^(?:${SRC_NB_JSON})*$`, 'u')
114	const NB_SINGLE_MULTI_LINE = new RegExp(`^(?:${SRC_NB_JSON}|\\n)*$`, 'u')
115	
116	// YAML 1.2.2 [170]-[182], projected to ScalarNode.value: source line breaks
117	// are normalized to LF; every other content character must be nb-char.
118	const BLOCK_SCALAR_CONTENT = new RegExp(`^(?:${SRC_NB_CHAR}|\\n)*$`, 'u')
119	
120	// YAML 1.2.2 [206] c-forbidden.
121	// https://yaml.org/spec/1.2.2/#912-document-markers
122	const C_FORBIDDEN_FIRST_LINE = /^(?:---|\.\.\.)(?=$|[ \t\n\r])/
123	const C_FORBIDDEN_CONTENT = /^(?:---|\.\.\.)(?=$|[ \t\n\r])/m
124	
125	function canUsePlain (layout: ScalarLayout): boolean {
126	  const str = layout.node.value
127	
128	  // Allow null to be rendered as an empty scalar; its tag is checked below.
129	  if (str !== '') {
130	    const nsPlain = layout.isKey
131	      ? (layout.flowOnly ? NS_PLAIN_FLOW_KEY : NS_PLAIN_BLOCK_KEY)
132	      : (layout.flowOnly ? NS_PLAIN_FLOW_IN : NS_PLAIN_FLOW_OUT)
133	
134	    if (!nsPlain.test(str)) return false
135	    if (layout.shiftOfFirstLine === 0 && C_FORBIDDEN_FIRST_LINE.test(str)) return false
136	
137	    if (layout.shiftOfContent === 0) {
138	      const firstLineBreak = str.indexOf('\n')
139	
140	      if (firstLineBreak !== -1) {
141	        const content = str.slice(firstLineBreak + 1)
142	
143	        if (C_FORBIDDEN_CONTENT.test(content)) return false
144	      }
145	    }
146	  }
147	
148	  // Outside the plain-syntax BNF: preserve the node tag under implicit resolution.
149	  const resolvedTag = layout.presenterOptions.schema.resolveImplicitScalarTag(str).tag.tagName
150	
151	  if (!layout.node.tagged && resolvedTag !== layout.node.tag) return false
152	
153	  // Outside YAML 1.2.2: preserve YAML 1.1 !!value semantics.
154	  // https://yaml.org/type/value.html
155	  if (!layout.node.tagged && str === '=' &&
156	      resolvedTag === layout.presenterOptions.schema.defaultScalarTag.tagName) return false
157	
158	  return true
159	}

content.text:
`forceQuotes` now quotes only string values; booleans, numbers and null stay plain and no longer get `!!bool`/`!!int`/`!!float`/`!!null` tags. After a rebuild the core tests pass (314 pass, 1 skipped, 0 fail), including a new test covering the report's example.

The cause was in `applyForceQuotesOption` in `src/ast/styler_defaults.ts`: it switched every plain non-key scalar to a quoted style regardless of its type, and the presenter then added an explicit tag to preserve the type. The fix is a single check that skips the rule unless the node's tag is the schema's default scalar (string) tag.

Other non-string scalars, such as timestamps, are also left unquoted under `forceQuotes` now.

The new test is in `test/core/units/dump-options.test.mjs`.
